revision: S1 schematic, P1 placement: 6HP motion recorder, four knobs zigzag, four CV outs, REC + RANGE buttons
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Single hole pair at X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right), as modules/12bit, hats and 16bit. The repository skiff rails are 10 mm wide centred on Y3.0/Y125.5, leaving the clear Y8.0..120.5 (112.5 mm) gap; the PCB keeps 1.25 mm margin at each end.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm (as modules/8bit and modules/12bit), 2 layers, 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end; held by the four jack bushings/nuts. The pots have no bushing or nut (user stock): soldered only. All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm copper-edge keep-out (min_copper_edge_clearance 1.0).

panel_order: Top to bottom: four knobs zigzag (1 left, 2 right, 3 left, 4 right), each with its motion LED in the opposite column of the same row; REC LED + REC button (left) and RANGE LED + RANGE button (right); OUT 1 / OUT 2; OUT 3 / OUT 4 at the bottom. Power header on B between the lower jacks.
row_note: Knob columns X7.95 / X22.05 (as modules/8bit: the RV09 courtyards keep 1.02 mm to the board edges), knob rows Y18.0 / 34.5 / 51.0 / 67.5 (16.5 mm pitch: neighbouring knobs 21.7 mm apart centre to centre, same-column knobs 33 mm). Button LEDs Y79.0, buttons Y85.5, jack rows Y96.25 / Y110.4 (courtyard pitch limit 14.1 mm; bottom courtyard 1.02 mm above the board edge). Jack columns X6.5 / X23.5: 1.45 mm outside the knob columns, which leaves 8.0 mm between the jack bodies for the power header pins. F courtyard gaps down the right column: RV4 to the RANGE LED 0.38 mm, LED to SW2 0.28 mm, SW2 to J2 0.70 mm.
jack_rotation_note: Rotation 0: T pad 4.92 mm above the bushing centre, TN 3.38 mm and S 6.48 mm below it.
pot_note: Bread Modular RV09 footprint (pins 7.5 mm below the shaft on 2.5 mm pitch, bracket tabs 9.6 mm apart on the shaft line). User stock pots, as modules/audio-out: no threaded bushing, no nut, 16 mm knurled shaft above the body; 3D proxy hardware/MOTION.3dshapes/RV09_proxy.step (from audio-out). pot_shaft_offset_mm = shaft centre relative to the footprint origin at rotation 0. Rotation 0: pins below the shaft, pin 1 on the left (front view), so CW turns the wiper toward pin 3.
button_note: modules/8bit SW1: generic 6 x 6 x 7 mm THT tact switch on the carrier F side, hand-soldered, placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre, rotation 0: pad 1 pair (button net) on the top row Y83.25, pad 2 pair (GND) Y87.75; legs X4.70 / X11.20 (SW1) and X18.80 / X25.30 (SW2). Same Z stack as 8bit, so its one-piece printed cap (modules/8bit/panels/button-actuator, flange D7) fits unchanged: flange 1.1 mm from the LED flange above and 1.2 mm from the jack body below (nominal).
led_note: 3 mm THT on F, rot 90: pads along Y centred on XY. Each motion LED sits beside its knob, in the opposite column of the same row; the REC and RANGE LEDs sit 6.5 mm above their buttons.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.led_note: 3 mm LED body (flange to dome) is 5.3 mm; body bottom at Z6.3 puts the dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front (Z11.6) and 0.4 mm recessed in the 2.0 mm print. The stock KiCad LED_D3.0mm model already stands its flange at Z3.0, so the board model offset is +3.3 mm.
stack_Z_mm.source: Slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks before committing the LED stand-off.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: User RV09 (as modules/audio-out): body 6.8 mm nominal, 1 mm collar, shaft to Z22.8 (11.2 mm past the FR4 front). No bushing, no nut. Measure a real pot before ordering panels.
stack_Z_mm.switch_note: Measured SW1: 7.0 mm tall, body 3.1 mm, tapered stem 3.9 mm (Ø3.4 at the body to Ø3.2 at the top). switch_stem_D is the mean stem diameter in the socket grip zone (Z4.5..7.0: Ø3.33..3.2).

power_header.orientation: Vertical on the board centre line between the lower output jacks (as modules/16bit R2), rot 180 on B: odd pins on the left column X13.73, even pins on X16.27; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom Y116.0, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top Y105.84. Courtyard X11.94..18.07, Y104.05..117.80 (1.45 mm above the bottom edge).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board. Envelope = 2x8 socket body (25.4 x 6.4 mm, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a ~1.2 mm key bump on either side; its lower end is 0.56 mm past the board edge, inside the rail gap (Y120.5), as modules/16bit R2. No THT lead under it: the jack pads end at X8.05 / start at X21.95, the switch pads end at Y88.75. B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.
power_header.assembly_note: The header pins are soldered on F between the J3 / J4 bodies (8.0 mm apart): solder J5 before the jacks.

back_side_tht.note: Eurorack power, centre line between OUT 3 and OUT 4, vertical, rot 180 on B: pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom
UPDI (pin 1 UPDI at the top Y41.73, pin 2 GND Y44.27), left edge between the motion LED 2 and knob 3, hand-soldered on B

smd_parking.note: tools/build_layout.py parks every SMD part here, off the right board edge, in reference order. They move onto the board group by group with the manual routing (root AGENTS.md); the routed native PCB then owns placement and copper .
